blurb: Dulce Upfront is a vibrant, community-rooted multicultural arts organization dedicated to uplifting artists, cultural workers, and organizers through access, collaboration, and care. Located in the heart of Fresno, Dulce operates out of St. Dulce, the physical space used for workshops, performances, pop-ups, and cultural gatherings that center BIPOC, queer, and grassroots voices.
